papers.title: Robust Variational Model Based Tailored UNet: Leveraging Edge Detector and Mean Curvature for Improved Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: To address the challenge of segmenting noisy images with blurred or fragmented boundaries, this paper presents a robust version of variational model based tailored UNet, a hybrid framework that integrates variational methods with deep learning. The proposed approach incorporates physical priors, an edge detector and a mean curvature term, into a modified Cahn-Hilliard equation, aiming to combine the interpretability and boundary-smoothing advantages of variational partial differential equations with the strong representational ability of deep neural networks. The architecture consists of two collaborative modules: an F module, which conducts efficient frequency domain preprocessing to alleviate poor local minima, and a T module, which ensures accurate and stable local computations, backed by a stability estimate. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets indicate that the proposed method achieves a balanced trade-off between performance and computational efficiency, which yields competitive quantitative results and improved visual quality compared to pure convolutional neural network based models, while achieving performance close to that of transformer-based method with reasonable computational expense.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】为了解决噪声图像分割问题（这些图像的边界可能模糊或不连续），本文提出了一种基于变分模型的改进型UNet框架。该框架结合了变分方法与深度学习技术，具有较高的鲁棒性。所提出的方法将物理先验、边缘检测器以及平均曲率项融入到改进后的Cahn-Hilliard方程中，旨在同时发挥变分偏微分方程在可解释性和边界平滑方面的优势，以及深度神经网络在表征能力方面的强大优势。该架构包含两个协同工作的模块：F模块负责高效的频域预处理，以克服局部最小值问题；T模块则通过稳定性估计确保局部计算的准确性和稳定性。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在性能与计算效率之间实现了良好的平衡，其定量结果具有竞争力，视觉质量也得到了提升。与纯卷积神经网络模型相比，该方法在计算开销相对较低的情况下，仍能够达到与基于Transformer的模型相近的性能水平。。研究方法：实验方法、深度学习、神经网络。

papers.title: Inclusive Islamic Financing for Advancing Sustainable Intensification among Oil Palm Smallholders
papers.venue: SRIWIJAYA INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF DYNAMIC ECONOMICS AND BUSINESS
papers.abstract: This study develops an Islamic financing model designed for the independent oil palm smallholders in West Pasaman, Indonesia that supports sustainable intensification. Using the Research and Development (R&D) approach of design science, combining survey and interview data from 187 farmers and 15 expert informants respectively. The findings demonstrate that the economically viable sustainable intensification of oil palm smallholders in West Pasaman is challenged by a lack of adequate planting material, poor financing, and limited technical capabilities coupled with fragmented institutional coordination. However, there is considerable potential in the region for oil palm-cattle integration and for intercropping. The study proposes a financing model that integrates Islamic commercial and social finance with technical support andinstitutional collaboration. This study contributes to existing financing literature by asserting that Islamic finance is a source of capital collaboration mechanism for oil palm smallholders to shift toward more sustainable in farming intensification systems.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究为印度尼西亚西帕萨曼地区的独立油棕小农户开发了一种伊斯兰融资模式，旨在支持可持续的农业集约化发展。该研究采用了设计科学中的研发（R&D）方法，结合了187位农民和15位专家受访者的调查数据与访谈信息。研究结果表明，西帕萨曼地区油棕小农户实现经济上可行的可持续集约化发展面临诸多挑战，主要包括种植材料短缺、融资渠道不畅、技术能力有限以及机构协调机制不完善等问题。然而，该地区在油棕与牛的结合养殖以及间作种植方面具有巨大潜力。研究提出的融资模式将伊斯兰商业金融与社会金融相结合，并辅以技术支持与机构协作。通过这项研究，我们进一步证实了伊斯兰金融作为一种资本合作机制，能够帮助油棕小农户转向更加可持续的农业集约化发展路径，从而为现有金融研究文献做出了贡献。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Optimal Order of Multi-Agent and General Many-Body Systems
papers.abstract: This paper develops a general framework for analyzing multi-agent systems with feedback loops between agents actions and collective observations. The framework is built on two fundamental agent-level variables: power, which measures agent influence on collective outcomes, and response functions, which determine how agents react to observations. We derive how macroscopic properties, including total power, useful power, entropy, order, fragility, and mobility, emerge from these two variables of heterogeneous agents. To study the trade off between growth and resilience, we introduce a system-level utility function parameterized by a risk-appetite coefficient and derive an optimal degree of order that balances productivity, stability, and adaptability. The analysis suggests that stronger synchronization can increase collective output but may also increase systemic fragility and reduce mobility. We further argue that order, entropy, information, and useful energy are task-dependent and system-relative concepts whose meanings depend on the objectives of the system. By measuring and designing agent power distributions and response functions, it may be possible to better understand, predict, and optimize collective behavior and identify the conditions under which collective intelligence and optimal order emerge.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文构建了一个通用框架，用于分析具有代理行为与集体观察之间反馈循环的多智能体系统。该框架基于两个基本的智能体层面变量：一是“权力”（power），用于衡量智能体对集体结果的影响；二是“响应函数”（response functions），用于确定智能体对观察结果的反应方式。我们推导出如何从这些异质智能体的两个变量中产生宏观属性，包括总权力（total power）、有效权力（useful power）、熵（entropy）、秩序（order）、脆弱性（fragility）和流动性（mobility）。为了研究增长与韧性之间的权衡，我们引入了一个由风险偏好系数（risk-appetite coefficient）参数化的系统级效用函数，并得出了一个能够平衡生产力（productivity）、稳定性和适应性（adaptability）的最优秩序程度。分析表明，更强的同步性可以提高集体产出，但也可能增加系统的脆弱性并降低流动性。我们进一步认为，秩序、熵、信息和有效能量是依赖于任务和系统的概念，其含义取决于系统的具体目标。通过测量和设计智能体的权力分布及响应函数，有可能更好地理解、预测和优...。

papers.title: Choosing A Headline Estimand from Matching, DID, and Hybrid Designs: A Minimax-Regret Approach
papers.abstract: Researchers using panel data to estimate causal effects routinely choose among three approaches to using past outcomes: difference-in-differences (DID), conditioning on lagged outcomes (matching, M), and a hybrid that does both (DIDM). The corresponding identifying assumptions are non-nested, leaving little guidance on which to report. We give conditions under which the corresponding estimands are ordered, with DIDM bracketed between matching and DID. This makes DIDM the minimax-regret choice among the three under a broad class of loss functions. We recommend reporting DIDM as the headline estimate, with matching and DID as bounds. We illustrate in applications.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】研究人员在使用面板数据估计因果效应时，通常会在三种处理过去结果的方法中做出选择：差异-in-differences（DID）、基于滞后结果的匹配方法（matching, M），以及结合这两种方法的混合方法（DIDM）。这些方法所依赖的识别假设均为非嵌套型（non-nested），因此关于应选择哪种方法缺乏明确的指导。我们提出了在何种条件下这些估计量的排序是有意义的，并指出在大多数损失函数（loss functions）的框架下，DIDM是三种方法中的最优选择。我们建议将DIDM作为主要估计结果进行报告，而将匹配方法和DID作为其置信区间（bounds）。我们通过具体应用实例来说明这一观点。。研究方法：双重差分、面板数据。

papers.title: Decision-making under model misspecification: an application to climate policy
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  While models used to evaluate climate change are inherently simplified, and thus imperfect, representations of reality, they remain indispensable tools for quantifying policy impacts and guiding decision-making. How can we leverage these models while accounting for their potential misspecification -the possibility that none of the existing models is adequate? This paper addresses this question by applying recent advances in decision theory to analyze how concerns about model misspecification influence key climate strategies, including the stringency of emissions targets and the extent of climate overshoot. Using a decision-theoretic framework applied to emulators of IPCC-assessed scenarios, we quantify the trade-offs between mitigation costs and climate-induced economic damages. We show that when decision-makers explicitly account for the possibility of model misspecification, they rationally adopt more ambitious climate goals, characterized by stricter carbon budgets and reduced reliance on emissions overshoot. These results underscore the importance of integrating model misspecification concerns into climate policy design, providing a rigorous foundation for precautionary and robust decision-making under deep uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：面对气候模型固有的简化与不完美，决策者应如何利用这些工具同时考量模型误设的风险？

🔬 研究方法：该研究将决策理论应用于IPCC评估情景的模拟器，量化了缓解成本与气候损害之间的权衡。

📊 核心发现：当决策者明确考虑模型误设的可能性时，会理性地采用更雄心勃勃的气候目标，表现为更严格的碳预算和减少排放超调。

💡 应用价值：这强调了将模型误设担忧整合到气候政策设计中，为深度不确定性下的谨慎和稳健决策提供严谨基础。

papers.title: Latin American Central Banks Governance: Exploring Trade‐Offs, Conflicts of Interest, Performance, and Board Members' Characteristics
papers.abstract: This article examines the governance of Latin American central banks, focusing on trade‐offs arising from multiple mandates, governance design, and central bank board characteristics. The analysis combines a qualitative review of central bank statutes with an original panel dataset covering eight Latin American central banks over the period 2004–2023. Using fixed‐effects panel regressions, the study explores how governance arrangements and board composition are associated with inflation outcomes, the inflation target level, and the inflation target interval. The results indicate that governance design is primarily associated with differences in the structure of inflation‐targeting frameworks rather than with inflation levels. Higher levels of central bank independence are consistently associated with narrower inflation target intervals, which may reflect tighter control over short‐run inflation deviations. Board member characteristics display selective associations: political affiliation and board heterogeneity are linked to inflation outcomes in some specifications, while academic qualifications, gender composition, and professional background are more closely related to the calibration of inflation‐targeting instruments, particularly the inflation target interval. These associations are stronger for continuous measures of policy design than for binary indicators of inflation target achievement, which are more closely related to macroeconomic conditions and inflation persistence. Overall, the findings suggest that central bank governance in Latin America operates mainly through institutional design and policy calibration rather than through immediate adjustments in inflation outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文研究了拉丁美洲中央银行的治理结构，重点探讨了多重职责、治理设计以及中央银行董事会特征所带来的权衡。分析结合了对中央银行章程的定性审查以及一个涵盖2004至2023年间八家拉丁美洲中央银行的原创面板数据集。通过使用固定效应面板回归模型，研究探讨了治理安排和董事会构成与通胀结果、通胀目标水平及通胀目标区间之间的关系。研究结果表明，治理设计主要影响通胀目标框架的构建方式，而非通胀水平本身。较高的中央银行独立性通常与更窄的通胀目标区间相关，这可能意味着对短期通胀偏离的管控更为严格。董事会成员的特征也表现出一定的关联性：在某些情况下，政治背景和董事会的多样性会影响通胀结果；而学术资格、性别构成及专业背景则与通胀目标工具的设定（尤其是通胀目标区间的确定）更为密切相关。这些关联性在连续型政策设计指标上更为显著，而非二元型的通胀目标实现指标（这些指标与宏观经济状况和通胀持续性关系更为紧密）。总体而言，研究结果表明，拉丁美洲中央银行的治理主要通过制度设计和政策调整来实现，而非直接对通胀结果进行即时调整。。研究方法：回归分析、面板数据、面板回归。

papers.title: THE PEER EFFECTS OF ASEAN COUNTRIES' TRADE WITH CHINA
papers.venue: World journal of economics and business research.
papers.abstract: In order to address empirical difficulties in research examining peer effects in ASEAN countries, this study employs trade data between ASEAN members and China to scrutinize the influence of geographical, economic, political, and cultural peer effects on ASEAN-China trade. The key findings are as follows: (1) There are significant positive peer effects in the geographical features of ASEAN countries, while significant negative peer effects are observed in the dimensions of trade openness, governance quality, and citizen Voice. (2) When it comes to peer effects of ASEAN countries' export to China, they are less influenced by geographically adjacent countries but are significantly influenced by the governance quality of neighboring countries. The significance of peer effects among ASEAN countries has decreased after the signing of the upgraded agreement of the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area. (3) Dynamic spatial Durbin model regressions demonstrate significant peer effects in geographical, economic, political, and cultural characteristics of ASEAN countries' trade with China. From a spatiotemporal dimension, the influence of the previous period's trade with China in peer countries on the focal country's trade with China is less than the influence of the focal country's previous period's trade with China.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】为了解决研究东盟国家中同伴效应时所遇到的实证难题，本研究利用东盟成员国与中国之间的贸易数据，来分析地理、经济、政治和文化因素对东盟与中国贸易的影响。主要研究结果如下：（1）在东盟国家的地理特征方面存在显著的正面同伴效应，而在贸易开放度、治理质量以及公民话语权等维度上则观察到显著的负面同伴效应；（2）就东盟国家对中国的出口而言，其贸易表现受地理邻近国家的影晌较小，但受到邻国治理质量的显著影响；（3）在中国-东盟自由贸易区升级协议签署后，东盟国家之间的同伴效应重要性有所减弱；（4）动态空间Durbin模型回归分析表明，东盟国家在与中国的贸易中，地理、经济、政治和文化特征均具有显著的同伴效应。从时空角度来看，先前时期与邻国之间的贸易对目标国家与中国贸易的影响，小于目标国家自身先前时期与中国贸易的影响。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Beyond the Keyboard: Pianists’ Project-Based Practice and Transferable Capacities
papers.venue: Resonance Journal of Global Music Studies
papers.abstract:
本文由一场面向高校音乐专业学生的公开讲座整理而成。文章以“琴键之外”为线索，围绕钢琴学习者在演奏与教学之外可能面对的艺术现场和职业情境，讨论钢琴训练所形成的能力如何被重新认识、调整和运用。文章结合作者在国际古典音乐项目、艺术家个人事务、艺术传播、内容制作及钢琴教学等方面的实践经历，分析钢琴专业能力在机构项目系统、艺术家个人工作系统、媒介传播和个人职业发展中的转化方式。
文章认为，钢琴训练培养的并不只是演奏技术，还包括对细节的感知、对结构的判断、对审美分寸的把握、持续执行的能力以及反复修正的习惯。这些能力可以延伸至项目组织、内容传播、教育实践和职业选择等更复杂的艺术工作场景，但这种延伸并不会自然发生。原有能力只有进入新的任务目标、受众对象、平台规则、协作关系和组织结构之中，才可能被重新激活并转化为具体的工作方法。本文不试图提出固定的职业发展模式，而是通过实践经验，为钢琴学习者理解专业身份、能力迁移和音乐职业发展的多种可能提供一种观察路径。
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】本文基于一场面向高校音乐专业学生的公开讲座整理而成。文章以“琴键之外”为主题，探讨了钢琴学习者在演奏与教学之外可能遇到的各种艺术场景和职业环境，并思考了钢琴训练所培养的能力如何被重新认识、调整和应用于实际工作中。作者结合自己在国际古典音乐项目、艺术家个人事务、艺术传播、内容制作以及钢琴教学等方面的实践经验，分析了钢琴专业能力在机构项目、艺术家个人工作、媒介传播和个人职业发展中的转化过程。

文章指出，钢琴训练不仅培养演奏技巧，还涉及对音乐细节的敏锐感知、对音乐结构的深刻理解、对审美标准的精准把握、持续执行任务的能力以及不断修正错误的习惯。这些能力可以应用于项目组织、内容传播、教育实践和职业选择等更为复杂的艺术领域，但这种转化并非自然而然发生。只有当原有的能力融入新的任务目标、受众群体、平台规则、协作关系和组织结构中，才能被重新激活并转化为具体的工作方法。本文并不试图提供一种固定的职业发展模式，而是通过分享实践经验，为钢琴学习者提供一条理解自身专业身份、实现能力迁移以及推动音乐职业发展的路径。。

papers.title: Advanced Calibration Analysis and Tools: Identifying Influential Observations in Stochastic Interest Rate Model Calibration
papers.abstract: The accurate calibration of interest rate models is central to market-consistent valuation and Economic Scenario Generators (ESGs). Traditional calibration methods for multi-factor models such as the G2++ model often rely on point estimates, neglecting the influence of specific market data and the quantification of estimation uncertainty. This paper develops a diagnostic framework embedding the calibration problem into non-linear regression theory. It shows that the common industry practice of minimizing the Root Mean Squared Relative Error (RMSRE) is equivalent to a Weighted Least Squares (WLS) problem. This equivalence yields the corresponding formulations for diagnostic tools, including the Weighted Hat Matrix for leverage analysis, Influence Functions for local sensitivity diagnostics, and the Functional Delta Method for local, boundary-respecting confidence intervals. The implementation uses an efficient Jacobian factorization that exploits the analytical tractability of At-The-Money (ATM) caps. The framework is applied to a dataset of Euro ATM caps covering the period 2016--2025. Our empirical analysis reveals a boundary-dominated leverage profile, repeated losses of effective dimensionality due to active parameter constraints, and a diagnostic regime shift in local parameter stability around the post-2022 market transition. The resulting message for actuarial model governance is that low RMSRE is not sufficient for calibration validation. We conclude by discussing the framework's applicability to general least-squares problems while highlighting the computational challenges for instruments lacking closed-form gradients, such as swaptions.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】利率模型的精确校准对于市场一致的估值和经济情景生成器（ESGs）至关重要。传统的多因子模型校准方法（如G2++模型）通常依赖于点估计，忽略了特定市场数据的影响以及估计不确定性的量化。本文构建了一个将校准问题嵌入到非线性回归理论中的诊断框架。研究表明，业界普遍采用的最小化均方根相对误差（RMSRE）的做法实际上等同于加权最小二乘（WLS）问题。这种等价性为诊断工具提供了相应的数学表述，包括用于杠杆分析的加权帽子矩阵（Weighted Hat Matrix）、用于局部敏感性诊断的影响函数（Influence Functions），以及用于生成尊重边界条件的置信区间的功能Delta方法（Functional Delta Method）。在实现过程中，我们采用了高效的雅可比矩阵分解技术，充分利用了平价期权（At-The-Money, ATM）合约的解析特性。该框架被应用于2016至2025年期间的欧元平价期权数据集。实证分析揭示了以下现象：杠杆率分布受边界条件显著影响；由于参数约束的存在，模型的有效维度反复降低；并且在2022年市场转型之后，局部参数稳定性出现了诊断意义上的变化。这对精算...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Institutions, Inputs, and Agricultural Growth in China:Revisiting Several Controversies, 1949--1986
papers.abstract: Scholarly debates on China's agricultural growth between 1949 and 1986 continue to differ over the extent of the price scissors, the effect of heavy industrial investment, the role of the 1978 reforms, and the impact of decollectivization on irrigation. Using a single dataset and complementary econometric methods, this paper addresses each of these controversies. The results show that 1952--1957 was the only net extraction period across all three channels, after which the state channelled a net inflow of about 168.6 billion yuan into agriculture via fiscal and credit instruments. Heavy industrial investment exerted a significant positive lagged effect on agriculture, while the contemporaneous negative correlation stemmed from the zero-sum nature of the investment share indicator. The input-output elasticity shifted abruptly in 1970, and collective agricultural loans broke in 1971, both pointing to the rectification effects of the North China Agricultural Conference. Disaster prevention capacity fell from 0.70 under the collective era to 0.53 after household contracting, mainly because the collective maintenance system collapsed rather than because state investment declined. After 1979 the price elasticity of agricultural supply approached zero, suggesting that the 1979 procurement price increase acted more like a one-off recalibration than a sustained marginal incentive.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】关于1949年至1986年间中国农业增长的学术争论仍在持续，主要涉及“价格剪刀效应”的程度、重工业投资的影响、1978年改革的作用以及农村集体化解除对灌溉系统的影响等方面。本文利用单一数据集和多种计量经济学方法，对这些问题进行了探讨。研究结果表明：1952年至1957年是这三个因素共同对农业产生净促进作用的唯一时期；此后，政府通过财政和信贷手段向农业领域注入了约1686亿元人民币的资金。重工业投资对农业产生了显著的滞后性正面影响，而同期出现的负面相关性则源于投资份额指标的零和特性。1970年农业生产的投入产出弹性发生了急剧变化，1971年集体农业贷款制度也被废除，这些变化均体现了“华北农业会议”所实施的改革措施的效果。灾害防控能力从集体化时期的0.70下降到家庭承包制实施后的0.53，主要原因在于集体维护体系的崩溃，而非政府投资的减少。1979年后，农业供给的价格弹性趋近于零，这表明1979年实施的收购价格上调更像是一次性的调整措施，而非持续的激励机制。。

papers.title: Two-Sample IV: Efficient Two-Step Estimation and Tests for Overidentification and Weak-Instruments
papers.abstract: Two-sample IV is a popular estimation method when the outcome and treatment variables are available in different samples, whereas instruments are available in both samples. The standard estimator is two-sample two-stage least squares estimator, which is efficient under homoskedasticity and homogeneity of the samples. We develop a robust two-step procedure for efficient estimation under general heteroskedasticity and heterogeneity of the samples, and propose a related two-sample Hansen overidentification test. A key feature of our approach is that only summary statistics from the linear regressions of the reduced form and first-stage in the two samples are needed. These are the six objects of the estimated coefficient vectors, and the homoskedastic and heteroskedasticity robust estimated variance matrices. We further show that the first-stage F-statistic in the treatment sample can be used as a test for weak instruments in the standard way under homoskedasticity and homogeneity, with the relative bias here a proportional bias. We propose an extension of the effective F-statistic of Montiel-Olea and Pflueger (2013) for the heteroskedastic case, following the generalization in Windmeijer (2025). We illustrate the estimators and tests in an application studying the effect of education on voting behavior from Marshall (2019), with cluster robust inference.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】双样本工具变量（two-sample IV）是一种常用的估计方法，适用于结果变量和处理变量分别来自不同样本，但工具变量同时存在于这两个样本中的情况。标准的估计方法是双样本两阶段最小二乘法（two-sample two-stage least squares estimator），该方法在样本同方差性和同质性条件下具有较高的效率。我们提出了一种鲁棒的双步估计程序，能够在样本存在一般异方差性和异质性的情况下实现高效估计，并构建了一个相关的双样本汉森过度识别检验（two-sample Hansen overidentification test）。我们方法的一个关键特点是：仅需使用两个样本中线性回归的简化形式（reduced form）和第一阶段（first-stage）的汇总统计量即可进行估计。这些统计量包括六个系数向量以及同方差性和异方差性鲁棒估计的方差矩阵。进一步研究表明，在样本同方差性和同质性条件下，处理样本中的第一阶段F统计量可以按照标准方法用于检验工具变量的有效性；此时的相对偏差为比例偏差（proportional bias）。我们基于Windmeijer（2025）的推广...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Trends, Volatility, Correlations, and Critical Phenomena in Financial Markets
papers.abstract: We forecast future volatilities and correlations of financial markets based on the current trends in these markets. This complements previous work that models future expected returns by a cubic polynomial of the current trend strength. Empirically, we observe that volatilities and correlations tend to increase day after day in times of strong up- or down-trends. This effect is particularly pronounced in down-trends. It can be accurately quantified by quadratic polynomials of today's trend strengths, which refine common mean-reversion models of volatilities and correlations. Our results improve the prediction of market risk by accounting for market trends. They also support a recent proposal to model financial markets by a lattice gas near its critical point.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们根据金融市场当前的趋势来预测未来的波动性和相关性。这一研究补充了以往通过当前趋势强度的三次多项式来建模未来预期回报的方法。实证观察表明，在市场呈现强劲上升或下降趋势时，波动性和相关性往往会逐日增加，尤其是在下降趋势中这种效应更为明显。这种变化可以通过对当前趋势强度进行二次多项式拟合来准确量化，从而改进了传统的均值回归模型对波动性和相关性的预测。我们的研究结果通过考虑市场趋势，提高了对市场风险的预测能力。同时，这些结果也支持了最近提出的将金融市场视为接近临界点的格子气模型的观点。。
